notes.title: Ver 1.9 will be coming on 8/30
notes.content:
LOTS of super cool news to share very soon (as soon as we can), but right now we're announcing that version 1.9 will be coming on 8/30! This will bring us out of Early Access and add some basic improvements as well as more language support:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Dutch
[*] Portuguese
[/list]
There's more news coming soon​ so stay tuned!

notes.title: Now in Early Access!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! [b]Newt One[/b] is live on Steam now in Early Access!.

Current version (1.4) supports the following controllers:

[list]
[*] wired PS4
[*] wired XB1
[*] wired XB360 
[*] wired Switch Pro (PC only) 
[/list]

In the following languages:

[list]
[*] English
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[/list]

It also has all playable levels and content!

We've got a new version coming up soon as the 14th is the [i]official [/i]launch. The next version has some UX and UI updates as well as more language support including [i]Italian[/i], [i]German[/i], [i]Dutch[/i], and [i]Portuguese[/i]. We're also working on expanding controller support.

Thanks for the few folks who supported us through the 1st day of Early Access launch the some technical difficulties in the first 24 hours. Releasing our initial game on Steam was a bit weird, but I guess that is why Early Access exists! Particularly, I'd like to thank Ryan Dorkoski for being super helpful in helping get things iron out - a true champion among mere mortals, that one!

Shortly after launch we'll be releasing some new artwork and the official soundtrack. Stay tuned for details!
